bias.zh: 下行趋势 · 反弹受阻于 $186–189 下方

read.en: Bloom Energy rose 3.4% on Nov 6 to $173.24, trading $168.84–186.33 on above-average volume. It stays below the falling 5-day ($190.3), 10-day ($202.7), 30-day ($239.1) and 100-day ($242.1) and the rising 200-day ($222.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8, below zero and widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($227.85), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月6日上涨 3.4%，收于 $173.24，盘中区间 $168.84–186.33，成交量高于均值。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$190.3）、10 日（$202.7）、30 日（$239.1）和 100 日均线（$242.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$222.4）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方且差值扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$227.85），RSI 为 36。

read.en: No level changed: the $186.33 high stopped at the $185.9–189 resistance and the close gave most of it back. Resistance is $185.9–189 (Aug 24 and Oct 23 lows), then $190.3–194.9 (5-day, Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows) and $202.7 (10-day). Support is $168.8 (Nov 6 low), then $156–157.3 and $147.6–149.3. A close above $189 would target $194–195; below $168.8, $156–157.

r.en: Aug 24 low $185.9; Nov 6 high $186.3; Oct 23 low $189
